verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes support custom images with any dependency and arbitrary command execution via `exec`, so you can run Python, JavaScript or other runtimes inside them. The agent example also shows generated Python code being executed. Results come back process-style (a subprocess-like API returning output) plus filesystem access, with no structured rich-output layer such as charts, dataframes or typed results. missing for 10: a documented multi-language code-interpreter API (runtimes are user-assembled via images and shell commands), rich or structured result types beyond process output and files, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-runtime execution.
